records.text: Rob McCoy was apparently in Jerusalem on November 16 at an event billed as a celebration of Charlie Kirk's life.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: So America's Pastor Rob McCoy was in Jerusalem on November 16th, apparently. A couple days ago, he was at an event. It was billed as a celebration of the life of Charlie (Charlie Kirk).

verification.notes: Multiple established news sources, including Israel Hayom, The Jerusalem Post, and Fox News, confirm that Pastor Rob McCoy was in Jerusalem on November 16, 2025, delivering the main address at a tribute event honoring Charlie Kirk's life, organized by The Isaiah Projects and Gideon 300 at Beit Shmuel.

sources.title: Charlie Kirk Tribute Event Set for November 16 in Jerusalem | Israel Hayom

records.text: Erika Kirk wrote that a woman was sitting by 'my family's dedication sign' for restoring Zion Gate in Jerusalem.
records.speaker: Erika Kirk

appearances.snippet: Meet Darla (Romanian Israeli woman; surname unverified), ... a Romanian Jew that now calls Israel home. ... She was sitting by my family's dedication sign for restoring the Zion Gate in Jerusalem.

verification.notes: An archived reproduction of Erika's post contains the quoted account identifying this grandfather as Jewish and describing his involvement with Jerusalem's Zion Gate. This verifies that she made the post, not every underlying genealogical assertion.

records.text: Jack Solomon married Karla Frantzve in 2002 and financed the restoration of Zion Gate in Jerusalem.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Carla (Carla Frantzve) wasn't even married to Jack (Jack Solomon) until 2002. ... Solomon is the very man who financed the restoration of Zion's Gate in Jerusalem.

verification.notes: Biographical data identifies Jack David Solomon's 2002 marriage to Karla, and the Jerusalem Foundation independently lists Jack David and Pamela Solomon as donors to a 1984 Zion Gate preservation project. The evidence supports both the marriage timing and an earlier Zion Gate connection.

records.text: The CIA recruits directly from BYU and specifically from BYU's Jerusalem Center.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep rupRLXmSndU)

appearances.snippet: fortunately, someone told me. ... BYU has direct ties to the CIA. ... They recruit directly from BYU. And I am saying this with 100% certainty, it is not a conspiracy, and what is even more odd is that they recruit specifically from BYU Jerusalem in Israel.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous BYU reporting confirms that the CIA openly recruited and interviewed students at BYU and valued the university language programs. No current authoritative evidence was found that the CIA recruited specifically through the BYU Jerusalem Center. The general BYU recruitment claim is supported; the Jerusalem-specific extension is not.

records.text: Owens said Irgun bombed Jerusalem's King David Hotel, then used as British military headquarters, in 1946 and killed 91 people.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: They loved to use bombs in Jerusalem in 1946. To be clear, the hotel at that time was operating as as the British military headquarters in Jerusalem. ... They just bombed it, killing 91 people in one go in 1946. And yes, that gang came to America and manifested here.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous U.S. diplomatic reporting identifies the destroyed King David Hotel annex as the Palestine Government Secretariat, and archival records identify Irgun as the bomber, date the attack to 1946, and record 91 deaths. The hotel wing also housed British military offices.

sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1946: The Consul at Jerusalem to the Secretary of State
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous official report of the July 22, 1946 bombing of the government secretariat in the King David Hotel annex.

sources.title: The King David Hotel in Jerusalem after the bombing
sources.relevance: National Library of Israel archival record attributes the bombing to Irgun and records 91 deaths.
